name: UCSD Please Be Qualified 2024

venue.name: UC San Diego
venue.address: Price Center, UCSD, 9500 Gilman Dr, La Jolla, CA 92093

information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDPleaseBeQualified2024#38870-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. ![This competition is in partnership with West Coast Cubing, LLC](https://i.imgur.com/jmSpkQE.png)
